指标来自本机 LiveKit 媒体统计；没有音频流或尚无报告时显示未采到，不代表: Metrics come from LiveKit media statistics on this device. “No data” means there’s no audio stream or report yet, rather than zero delay or packet loss.
联系管理员时可提供此编号。网络恢复后会自动补交问题记录。: Share this ID when contacting an administrator. Issue reports are submitted automatically when the network recovers.
耳机和蓝牙由系统选择。来电中断、设备断开或权限收回后，需手动开麦。锁屏和切后台可: The system manages headphones and Bluetooth. Turn your microphone on manually after a call, device disconnection, or permission change. You can keep listening with the screen locked or the app in the background, subject to system network and background limits.
容量为当前保护配置，不是压测容量。质量为登录房内客户端自报的去标识短期聚合。: Capacity reflects current protective limits. It is not a load-test result. Quality metrics are anonymous, short-term aggregates reported by signed-in room clients.

默契合拍。聊天有种接得上话的感觉，共同兴趣很适合开场。偶尔分享一点不同想法，让熟: Easy chemistry. Conversation may flow naturally between you. Start with shared interests, then bring in a fresh perspective now and then to keep things interesting.

欢喜冤家。聊得来，也容易斗嘴，互动里常有一点小较劲。享受彼此懂的部分，较劲时缓一: Playful rivals. You may click easily and still enjoy a bit of banter. Enjoy the connection, slow down when things get competitive, and say what you mean.

互补来电。不同的思路能给聊天添些新鲜感，适合互相接住新点子。多问问对方为什么这样: Opposites spark ideas. Different ways of thinking can keep the conversation fresh. Build on each other’s ideas and ask what’s behind them to turn your differences into good conversation.
同频共鸣。关注的话题有些相近，接话亲切，又能听到不同角度。先聊共同兴趣，也给对方: On a similar wavelength. Shared interests may make conversation feel familiar, with room for fresh perspectives. Start with what you have in common and stay curious about each other’s quirks.
灵感搭子。适合交换思路，轮流当彼此的小老师。少一点说教，多一点好奇，问问对方的理: Inspiration partners. Swap ideas and take turns learning from each other. Stay curious, ask why, and leave room for discoveries without turning the conversation into a lecture.
同款默契。偏好相近，聊天像遇到熟悉的脑回路，接话很有亲切感。也多聊聊各自不同的经: Familiar minds. Similar preferences can make it easy to follow each other’s thoughts. Share your different experiences too, so a familiar connection keeps finding new stories.
自由搭配。你们没有固定的相处剧本，合不合拍可以边聊边发现。从共同兴趣开始，试试不: Find your own fit. There’s no set script for this pairing. Explore shared interests and try different topics to discover a conversation style that suits you both.
同频搭子。熟悉感是这组的聊天关键词，共同喜好很适合开场。别急着以为已经懂了对方，: A familiar vibe. Shared tastes can be an easy way to break the ice. Keep listening to the stories that make each of you different, even when the connection feels familiar.
好奇搭子。既有一点亲近感，也有值得好奇的不同之处。交换喜欢的小事和日常习惯，节奏: Curious companions. There’s a mix of familiarity and intriguing differences. Share small favorites and daily habits, and give each other time when your rhythms differ.
轻松接球。适合一来一回地接话，轻松互动就是这组的亮点。主动递个新话题或小游戏，也: Easy back-and-forth. Relaxed exchanges may be this pairing’s strength. Offer a new topic or a little game, and give the other person time to join in.
火花搭子。聊天有来有往，也容易因为不同想法斗嘴较劲。把想法说清楚，少让对方猜，一: Lively sparks. Different ideas can lead to lively exchanges and a little friendly rivalry. Be clear about what you mean and try a small challenge together to make the sparks fun.
舒服合拍。相处的关键词是自在，聊天不妨跟着舒服的节奏走。偶尔主动关心，或一起尝试: Comfortably in sync. Let the conversation find an easy pace. Check in with each other or try something new together to add warmth to a relaxed connection.
新奇磨合。想法和习惯可能不在同一频道，好奇心能打开新话题。把期待说具体，给彼此一: An intriguing adjustment. Your ideas and habits may differ, giving curiosity plenty to work with. Be specific about what you expect and give each other time to find a shared rhythm.
反差来电。不同的表达和习惯让互动有张力，也有互补的想象空间。先听懂另一边的想法，: Attraction in contrast. Different styles and habits can bring energy and balance to the conversation. Hear each other out and find common ground before jumping into debate.
